topPRs.title: op-acceptance-tests: Add skipped cycle prerequisite regression
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
This PR adds a reusable exact-chain interop setup for acceptance tests. The two-chain preset now starts exactly two chains. The three-chain preset starts exactly three chains. Both presets use the same runtime projection path.

It also adds a three-chain fault-proof scenario. Chains A and B form a dependency cycle. Chain C is an acyclic prerequisite of chain A. The scenario verifies that consolidation replaces only A and B, while preserving C. It runs through the shared Go and Kona proof runner path.

The regression remains skipped because the current cycle detection includes acyclic prerequisites. ethereum-optimism/optimism#22827 will stack on this PR, implement exact cycle participant detection, and enable the regression. This PR references ethereum-optimism/optimism#22825 without closing it.

topPRs.title: docs: fix create-l2 example path and stale README links
topPRs.author: imitater-dou
topPRs.body:
## Summary
Three verified docs drifts against `develop` tip `a3e9e91a83cde7708123d52727711baef270f093`:

1. **`docs/public-docs/create-l2-rollup-example/README.md`** told readers to `cd docs/create-l2-rollup-example`, but that path 404s. The example lives at `docs/public-docs/create-l2-rollup-example` (already used correctly in the tutorial `index.mdx`).
2. **`CONTRIBUTING.md`** linked `README.md#branching-model-and-releases`, which is not an existing heading. The correct anchor is `#development-and-release-process`.
3. **`README.md` Directory Structure** omitted `op-interop-filter` and `op-supernode`, both present on tip with their own packages/READMEs.

## Repro
```bash
TIP=a3e9e91a83cde7708123d52727711baef270f093

# 1) wrong example path (404)
gh api repos/ethereum-optimism/optimism/contents/docs/create-l2-rollup-example?ref=$TIP
# Not Found
gh api repos/ethereum-optimism/optimism/contents/docs/public-docs/create-l2-rollup-example?ref=$TIP
# DIR ok
rg -n 'cd docs/create-l2-rollup-example' <(curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/$TIP/docs/public-docs/create-l2-rollup-example/README.md)

# 2) dead CONTRIBUTING anchor
rg -n 'branching-model-and-releases' <(curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/$TIP/CONTRIBUTING.md)
rg -n '^## ' <(curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/$TIP/README.md) | rg -i 'branch|release|develop'

# 3) missing directory entries (packages exist)
gh api repos/ethereum-optimism/optimism/contents/op-interop-filter?ref=$TIP  # DIR
gh api repos/ethereum-optimism/optimism/contents/op-supernode?ref=$TIP      # DIR
```

## Change
- Correct the two `cd` paths in the create-l2 example README.
- Point CONTRIBUTING at `#development-and-release-process`.
- Add `op-interop-filter` and `op-supernode` lines to the README directory tree.

topPRs.title: op-deployer: Skip broken Sepolia chain upgrade subtest
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
The fork upgrade test does not handle chains where U20 is already applied. Its failure blocks merges through `go-tests` and `ci-gate`.

Temporarily skip only `TestEndToEndBootstrapApplyWithUpgrade/opcm_upgrade_test/upgrade_opcm_v2/upgrade_chain_v2`; sibling subtests remain active. Restore coverage when ethereum-optimism/optimism#22934 is resolved. This change does not affect production behavior.
